# FortiGate DHCP lease-time 600s on vlan150-160 (before step 3)
# Generated by plans/gen-fortigate-cli.py from the 13/14 Oct 2026 captures. Do not edit; re-run.
# Lines starting with # are comments for the reader; FortiOS ignores them when pasted.

# Run on the FortiGate a day or more before the renumbering (plan v2 section 9).
# Clients on 150-160 then hold 600-second leases and re-address within minutes after the PVID flip.
config system dhcp server
    edit 6   # vlan150
        set lease-time 600
    next
    edit 7   # vlan151
        set lease-time 600
    next
    edit 8   # vlan152
        set lease-time 600
    next
    edit 9   # vlan153
        set lease-time 600
    next
    edit 11   # vlan154
        set lease-time 600
    next
    edit 10   # vlan155
        set lease-time 600
    next
    edit 12   # vlan156
        set lease-time 600
    next
    edit 13   # vlan157
        set lease-time 600
    next
    edit 14   # vlan158
        set lease-time 600
    next
    edit 15   # vlan159
        set lease-time 600
    next
    edit 16   # vlan160
        set lease-time 600
    next
end

# Undo (after the renumbering, on the NEW vlan75-85 servers the lease is already 604800; the old servers get deleted).
